insights.summary: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 33% to a record ₹1,021 Cr with a 19.2% EBITDA margin; non-auto sales more than doubled to ₹200 Cr (21% of sales) and ADS revenue more than tripled to ₹145 Cr. A ~₹1,250 Cr semiconductor-equipment order after the quarter lifted the ADS backlog to ~₹5,700 Cr executable by FY31, and management guided high-teens to 20% growth with margins inching toward 19%. A ₹17 Cr US litigation settlement and a ₹13 Cr provision for US tariff duty hit the quarter.

what_changed.text: FY27 growth now high-teens to 20% (from 'similar trajectory')
ADS backlog up to ~₹5,700 Cr after a ~₹1,250 Cr semicon order
ADS capacity plan for ~₹3,500 Cr revenue by FY31
Dedicated defence facility and entry into sheet metal

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: I think, overall, if you see our non-ADS business, all other businesses put together, non-ADS business itself, we should be able to look at a mid-teen kind of growth easily.

analyst_questions.answer: High-teens to 20% this year with ADS up 75-80%; too early to promise 20%+ for FY27-29.
Q1 helped by 40% international mix and forex; aims to inch toward 19%; ADS and exports earn 25-30%.
Steel and labour cost claims with customers in progress, nothing booked yet; forex gave cushion.
Not ₹1,500 Cr next year; ramp depends on machine arrivals and validations; guidance at year-end.

red_flags.text: ₹12.6 Cr provision for US tariff duty from last year that may not be recovered.
Q1 margin flattered by forex and export mix; cost pass-through not yet received.
Supply-chain strain from strong demand; forging and heat-treatment expansion takes 18-24 months.
Mother-machine lead times (7-9 months) limit how fast ADS can scale.

watch_next: Q2 growth vs high-teens to 20% for the year
EBITDA margin near 19% once forex gains fade
Recovery of US tariff duty and steel pass-through
